title: Surreal Tower in Sphere
description: A tall ornate clock tower with multiple clock faces stands at the center of a large transparent sphere. The sphere rests on a vibrant patterned mandala in a green rolling hills landscape, with colorful spheres, butterflies, and birds floating around it under a clock-faced halo.
prompt: A tall ornate multi-story clock tower with several clock faces stands inside a large transparent bubble sphere, resting on an intricate red and gold circular mandala pattern. The sphere floats above vibrant green rolling hills with two small distant towers on the sides. Colorful balls, monarch butterflies, and birds fly around the sphere, with a large clock face halo above the tower, in a surreal dreamlike scene with soft lighting
